Which frame should be rendered when rendering a still. Default `0`. From v3.2.27, negative values are allowed, with `-1` being the last frame.

## CLI flag

Use `--frame` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                               | Flag              |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                   | `--frame <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)     | `--frame <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still) | `--frame <value>` |
